subject: SAP SuccessFactors replication window change from October

body.content:
From 1 October 2026 the nightly SuccessFactors to eBlox replication moves from 02:00 to 04:00 CET to avoid the SAP backup window.

Absence write-back stays every 4 hours. Clients with early payroll runs should check that their run is scheduled after 05:00.

subject: Colruyt: confirmation of meal voucher face value from January 2027

body.content:
Colruyt HR confirmed in writing that the meal voucher face value moves from €7 to €8 from 1 January 2027, employer part €6.91 and employee part €1.09.

Please prepare the eBlox change with effective date 2027-01-01 and run a simulation in December.
